# openpanel_project (Resource)

An OpenPanel Project. Projects scope SDK clients and event references; they are the unit a tenant app integrates against.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openpanel_project" "marketing_site" {
  name   = "Marketing site"
  domain = "example.com"
  # Space-separated origins allowed to ingest events via the SDK.
  cors = "https://example.com https://www.example.com"
}

output "project_id" {
  value = openpanel_project.marketing_site.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable Project name. Shown in the OpenPanel dashboard.

### Optional

- `cors` (List of String) List of allowed origins for the Project's write clients (the JS SDK CORS allowlist).
- `domain` (String) Primary site domain associated with the Project. Optional metadata.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `id` (String) Project ID assigned by OpenPanel.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the Organization this Project belongs to. Inferred from the provider's root Client credential.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import openpanel_project.marketing_site <project-id>
```
